item.description:
Restore fix, bookmark popover and link target (build 288)

  • Restore: after a Force Quit, each terminal tab resumes its own Claude conversation.
  • Background Claude daemon workers are no longer mistaken for a tab's agent.
  • When two tabs claim one conversation, Devkitty shows an alert instead of guessing.
  • Links: one Tab/Split setting now controls where links open from the terminal, the PR popover, Actions and CLI links.
  • Browser: right-click a link to bookmark it in a small popover (Bookmark Link... / Add/Edit Bookmark...).
  • Gauge: the details card shows the full reset countdown, for example 1d 2h 40m.
